abstract: A cross-sectional study of bone density involving 30 patients who had undergone orchidectomy and para-aortic radiotherapy for Stage I seminoma of the testis, has been performed. Bone density measurements were made of the whole body, lumbar spine and hips, including all irradiated areas. Comparison was made with previously obtained standard sex and age matched control data. The 30 patients treated for seminoma had a significantly increased mean bone density compared with age matched normal values. No significant differences were demonstrated between the mean bone densities of the irradiated and non-irradiated hips. There was no significant relationship between bone density measurement and time since orchidectomy or radiotherapy. These results suggest that nodal irradiation for seminoma has little long term effect on bone density.
abstract_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術および傍大動脈への放射線療法を受けた30例について、横断的研究を行った。全身、腰椎および股関節の骨密度を測定し、年齢および性別を合わせた既存の正常値データと比較した。セミノーマ治療を受けた30例の平均骨密度は、年齢を合わせた正常値と比較して有意に高かった。照射された股関節と照射されなかった股関節の平均骨密度に有意差は認められなかった。骨密度測定値と精巣摘除術後または放射線療法後の期間との間に有意な関連は認められなかった。これらの結果は、セミノーマに対するリンパ節照射が長期的な骨密度にほとんど影響しないことを示唆している。
